description_zh: 为Spring Cloud或Dubbo应用创建灰度规则
kebab_example: aliyun sae create-grey-tag-route --app-id 7802c49a-67bc-4167-8369-9a9c003c0000 --name dubbo-echo --description Canary_Release_-_Regions --sc-rules condition_:_OR_,_items_:_cond_:_==_,_name_:_grey_,_operator_:_rawvalue_,_type_:_param_,_value_:_true_,_cond_:_==_,_name_:_grey_,_operator_:_rawvalue_,_type_:_cookie_,_value_:_true_,_cond_:_==_,_name_:_grey_,_operator_:_rawvalue_,_type_:_header_,_value_:_true_,_path_:_/post-echo/hi --dubbo-rules condition_:_OR_,_group_:_DUBBO_,_items_:_cond_:_==_,_expr_:_.key1_,_index_:0,_operator_:_rawvalue_,_value_:_value1_,_cond_:_==_,_expr_:_.key2_,_index_:0,_operator_:_rawvalue_,_value_:_value2_,_methodName_:_echo_,_serviceName_:_com.alibaba.edas.boot.EchoService_,_version_:_1.0.0 --alb-rules condition_:_AND_,_items_:_cond_:_==_,_name_:_grey_,_operator_:_rawvalue_,_type_:_sourceIp_,_value_:_127.0.0.1_,_cond_:_==_,_name_:_grey_,_operator_:_rawvalue_,_type_:_cookie_,_value_:_true_,_cond_:_==_,_name_:_grey_,_operator_:_rawvalue_,_type_:_header_,_value_:_true_,_path_:_/post-echo/hi --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateGreyTagRoute

parameters.help_en: The name of the canary rule. The name can be up to 64 characters long and can contain only lowercase letters, digits, hyphens (-), and Chinese characters. It must start with a lowercase letter and end with a lowercase letter or a digit
parameters.help_zh: 规则名称。支持以小写字母开头，以数字或小写字母结尾，仅可包含小写字母、中文字符、数字及短划线（-）。不超过64个字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the canary rule. The description can be up to 64 characters long
parameters.help_zh: 规则描述。不超过64个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The canary rules for a Spring Cloud application. This parameter is required for Spring Cloud applications and cannot be used with the **DubboRules** parameter
parameters.help_zh: 为Spring Cloud应用创建的灰度规则。当您的应用为Spring Cloud框架时必填，且无需填写**DubboRules**参数
parameters.name: sc_rules

parameters.help_en: The canary rules for a Dubbo application. This parameter is required for Dubbo applications and cannot be used with the **ScRules** parameter
parameters.help_zh: 为Dubbo应用创建的灰度规则。当您的应用为Dubbo框架时必填，且无需填写**ScRules**参数
parameters.name: dubbo_rules

parameters.help_en: The canary rules for an application that uses an ALB gateway route
parameters.help_zh: 为配置好ALB网关路由的应用创建的灰度规则
parameters.name: alb_rules
